<subject>Re: Portfolio review week follow up</subject>
<body>
Great idea.  

My key points would be that (a) the Investment Committee needs to move forward with its "right sized" portfolio strategies and (b) focus on standardizing the asset allocation and reporting frameworks [no more drawn-out collaboration]. Two simple, easy to understand thoughts.  

Also, I think that it's a mistake to use the term "large portfolios".  We don't want large portfolios.  We want portfolios that cover natural sectors and benefit investors.

Preston
</body>
<quoted>
 -----Original Message-----
From: 	Jacobs, Brent  
Sent:	Friday, October 17, 2025 8:05 AM
To:	Shields, Victoria; Anthony, Robert Sanders. (PR); Andrews, Rose; Davis, Alan; Moreno, Gregory; Andrade, Preston; Burton, Alison
Subject:	Portfolio review week follow up

In the aftermath of portfolio review week and following up on Gregory's successful pre-briefings, we should be out spinning on the back end as well.  Perhaps Alison, Victoria and I can come up with some thoughts on message points and send them around for comment.  Sound OK?
</quoted>
